summary: Backend: 13/13 pytest passed (auth register/login/PUT me, google/session 401, alerts CRUD + send-now with sent:false & count>=0, employer company + job create/list/delete). Frontend: candidate login OK (no crash, dropdown shows), /profile renders with AlertsManager, create-alert-btn works, alert appears in profile, send-now/frequency change/delete work. Employer login can reach /post-job (form present) and /my-jobs (empty state OK). AuthModal shows only Google button — no Facebook/X/LinkedIn OAuth buttons. Discovered a P0 mixed-content bug: FastAPI trailing-slash 307 redirect downgrades HTTPS→HTTP for /api/applications and /api/saved-jobs (and any router with route path '/'), causing browser to block XHR on /my-applications and /saved-jobs pages.

critical.endpoint: /api/applications  and  /api/saved-jobs (and any router mounted with route path '/')
critical.issue: FastAPI returns 307 with Location: http://joboolo-staging.preview.emergentagent.com/api/applications/ (HTTP not HTTPS). Browser blocks the request as mixed content. Frontend service calls api.get('/applications') without trailing slash; backend defines route as @router.get('/') behind prefix, triggering the redirect. Same pattern in companies.py (route path '/').

integration_issues.issue: XHR blocked by browser (Mixed Content) — see backend critical issue above. Pages still render empty state because request just errors.

issues: Footer copyright says '© 2025 Indeed' and social links labeled Facebook / Twitter / LinkedIn — brand is Joboolo, should be updated.

action_items: FIX P0 mixed-content: either (a) set app = FastAPI(redirect_slashes=False) in backend/server.py, or (b) change route decorators from @router.get('/') to @router.get('') in applications.py, saved_jobs.py, companies.py, or (c) make frontend service always use trailing slash. Option (a) is the smallest, safest change.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend routes mount with prefix + route '/' causing 307 redirects that Kubernetes ingress rewrites to http:// — root cause of mixed-content on any GET to those routers without trailing slash.
auth.py register/login/get_me/put_me all rebuild UserResponse manually — DRY violation, extract to helper (_build_user_response already exists but only used in google_session).
alerts.py _id generation uses timestamp() only — collision-prone under concurrent creation; consider uuid4.

rca of the issue: FastAPI's default redirect_slashes=True issues a 307 when a request path doesn't match a route's trailing-slash form. The frontend axios client calls /api/applications (no slash); the backend route is defined as @router.get('/') inside a router with prefix /applications, so FastAPI redirects to /api/applications/. In this Kubernetes ingress setup the redirect Location header is built from the request scheme as seen by uvicorn (http), so the browser receives Location: http://.../api/applications/ and blocks the follow-up as mixed content. Fix in one line: FastAPI(redirect_slashes=False) — or align route paths to be trailing-slash-agnostic.
